newsitem.title: FRANCE: Kurds say Iraqi killed in clash.
newsitem.headline: Kurds say Iraqi killed in clash.

text.p: Kurdish guerrillas said on Monday they killed a member of Iraq's military intelligence in a clash with a rival, Iraqi-backed group in northern Iraq.
The Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), in a statement issued in Paris, said the dead Iraqi was identified from his documents as Salah Salim Ahmed.
It said three other people were killed in the weekend clash with members of the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP), near Mawat, east of Sulaimaniya.
PUK said Iraqi intelligence and army officers dressed in Kurdish gear were actively engaged in planning and directing a KDP offensive against PUK forces from the area.

KDP guerrillas backed by Iraqi forces launched an offensive against the PUK earlier this month, prompting the United States to fire missiles at Iraq and extend a no-fly zone in the south of the country.
